sentence: ﻿The product misses speaker context and puts wrong owners on tasks.
It is difficult to share highlights with managers without reformatting everything.
Support is slow when we report bugs before renewal.
﻿The transcript summary is often inaccurate and misses key objections from the prospect.
Setup was frustrating because the CRM fields did not map correctly.
We canceled after two months because reps did not trust the notes.
﻿Our reps complain that note cleanup is still manual and takes too long after every call.
Search is broken when trying to find action items from last quarter.
Pricing feels expensive for a tool that still needs constant editing.
